notes.zh: 首次公開版本：人體感應器（ESP32-C3）通用韌體。Wi-Fi 設定預設留空，首次啟動後用配網方式設定。韌體以 GPL-3.0 開源，對應原始碼放在本專案的 esphome/ 資料夾。刷入前請先備份原廠韌體。
notes.en: First public release: general-purpose firmware for the presence sensor (ESP32-C3). Wi-Fi credentials are empty by default; set them up through provisioning after the first boot. The firmware is open source under GPL-3.0, and the matching source code is in the esphome/ folder of this project. Please back up the original firmware before flashing.
